open_questions.OQ-001: Which enforcement posture (cooperative, platform-managed, or network/IAM-enforced) is required for the first external customers?
open_questions.OQ-002: Is PrivateLink / private connectivity required for Mode A or Mode B, and by when?
open_questions.OQ-003: Which AWS Regions are supported at GA, and how are per-tenant residency commitments enforced?
open_questions.OQ-004: When does streaming output evaluation ship, and what applies to streaming workloads until then?
open_questions.OQ-005: When are retrieval-content evaluation and indirect prompt-injection detection introduced?
open_questions.OQ-006: What is the scope and timing of tool-call validation, tool-result evaluation, and MCP authorization?
open_questions.OQ-007: When are human approval workflows introduced, and who owns the approval UX?
open_questions.OQ-008: When are multilingual policy packs introduced, and which languages first?
open_questions.OQ-009: What measurable trigger moves the MVP from two AWS accounts to three-or-more?
open_questions.OQ-010: When (if ever) are dedicated tenant runtimes and air-gapped installation offered?
open_questions.OQ-011: Will commercial metering and a policy marketplace be pursued, and on what timeline?
open_questions.OQ-012: How will policy signing and policy inheritance work once introduced?
open_questions.OQ-013: What is the security and compatibility review model for customer-specific evaluator plugins?
open_questions.OQ-014: What are the objective go/no-go criteria to promote a workload from observe to enforce?
open_questions.OQ-015: Which compliance certifications (if any) are targeted, and for which phase?
open_questions.OQ-016: Is multi-region active-active availability ever required, independent of data residency?
open_questions.OQ-017: Do resource/cost guardrails (catalog GR-012) require extending the evaluation contract with token/cost metadata?
open_questions.OQ-018: Should the evaluation-stage vocabulary expand beyond the seven reserved stages (e.g. `retrieval_query`, `agent_plan`, `memory_read`, `tool_selection`)?
open_questions.OQ-019: What is the canonical reason-code taxonomy, and does guardrail category become a first-class audit/metric dimension?
open_questions.OQ-020: Who holds authority to mark a policy Mandatory, and can an app-team or tenant admin weaken or override a mandatory policy?
open_questions.OQ-021: Does "select policy" in the onboarding flow mean one policy version, or a set the consumer composes?
open_questions.OQ-022: How long is a connector version supported, and what happens to a workload that never upgrades?

CON-001.short: AWS is the primary and initial cloud platform

CON-002.short: MVP account model: one non-prod account + one prod account

CON-003.short: Public contract must not couple to LiteLLM configuration structures

CON-004.short: Public contract must not couple to Bedrock Guardrails response formats

CON-005.short: One logical evaluation contract across Remote, Gateway, and Customer-Managed modes

CON-006.short: Policies and connectors are mandatorily separate

CON-007.short: Every deployment must document content exposure explicitly

CON-008.short: TLS required for all runtime communication

CON-009.short: KMS encryption in transit and at rest

CON-011.short: Per-tenant workload identities; no cross-tenant sharing

CON-012.short: No exclusive reliance on API keys, unauthenticated identifiers, unauthenticated policy versions, or telemetry as security

CON-013.short: Raw content must not leave a customer-managed runtime unless explicitly configured

CON-014.short: No raw-content retention by default in the hosted runtime

CON-015.short: Input-size limits enforced on all evaluated content

CON-016.short: Timeout limits enforced on every evaluation stage

NFR-PRIV-001.short: No raw content retention by default

NFR-PRIV-004.short: Configurable telemetry down to none (Mode C)

NFR-COST-001.short: Cost model before Guarded Gateway GA

NFR-COST-002.short: Usage quotas / rate controls bound cost
